gloss: to gather; to assemble; to meet up

definitions.gloss: to gather; to assemble; to meet up at a designated place and time
definitions.explanation: Used when people come together at an agreed location. Common in school, work, and group activity contexts.

examples.japanese: {九時|くじ}に{駅前|えきまえ}に{集合|しゅうごう}してください。
examples.english: Please meet at the station at nine o'clock.

examples.japanese: {全員|ぜんいん}が{集合|しゅうごう}したら{出発|しゅっぱつ}します。
examples.english: We'll depart once everyone has gathered.

examples.japanese: {避難|ひなん}{訓練|くんれん}では{校庭|こうてい}に{集合|しゅうごう}することになっている。
examples.english: During evacuation drills, we're supposed to assemble in the schoolyard.

notes:
Very common in everyday Japanese for organizing group meetups, school events, and workplace gatherings. The noun form {集合|しゅうごう} can be used as a command: {集合|しゅうごう}！(Assemble! / Gather round!). Also used in math for "set" ({集合|しゅうごう}{論|ろん} = set theory).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {集合|しゅうごう}{時間|じかん}: meeting time
- {集合|しゅうごう}{場所|ばしょ}: meeting place
- {集合|しゅうごう}{住宅|じゅうたく}: apartment complex, housing complex

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {集|あつ}まる: to gather (intransitive, more natural/spontaneous)
- {合流|ごうりゅう}する: to join up, merge (used when joining an existing group)
